observations.body: Jesus takes Peter, James, and John up a high mountain, is transfigured before them, and answers Peter’s tents after Moses and Elijah appear; a bright cloud and voice redirect the three before the descent.
observations.label: After six days

observations.body: The passage presents Seeing, speaking, listening, and descending as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Seeing, speaking, listening, and descending

observations.body: The passage places The voice names the beloved Son beside Seeing, speaking, listening, and descending.
observations.label: The voice names the beloved Son

payload.posture: Read Matthew 17:1–13 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus takes Peter, James, and John up a high mountain, is transfigured before them, and answers Peter’s tents after Moses and Elijah appear; a bright cloud and voice redirect the three before the descent. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: After six days
